bio.text: Steve Hohe is the Libertarian candidate for Kansas's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic Rep. Sharice Davids.
He previously ran for the seat in 2016, 2020 and 2022, and in 2024 ran for the Kansas Statehouse.
KCUR reports that, based on available records, he has not held public office.
